profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Developer | MPH
profile.summary:
Full Stack Web Developer with a background in Public Health research and education and client outreach through digital media. Recently earned a Certificate in Web Development from the University of Arizona with skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and MVC and MERN Stack oriented web design and technologies. Effective communicator and team player with a penchant for organization and developing user-friendly, yet eye-catching design. Known by peers to be a driven problem-solver and charismatic helper and learner. I applied my cumulative skills with a team of four and developed an intuitive, single-page MERN app that utilizes APIs that can be used to search events by location or by artist and be saved to a user profile. My aim is to develop MERN Stack applications that meet the client’s goals and enhance the user experience by leveraging my technical, professional, and interpersonal skills as part of a quality-driven team.

Before I started my journey in the tech field, I graduated Magna Cum Laude from UArizona with a Bachelor of Science in Public Health and a Masters in Public Health (Health Behavior/Health Promotion). I provided community nutrition education and worked on other projects aiming to bring about health equity through a socioecological lens.

positions.title: Community Outreach Assistant II
positions.description:
* Taught evidence-based nutrition to children, youth, and adults and achieved positive behavior change.

* Trained 15 peers in video conferencing, PowerPoint, Google Forms, and web-based design technologies (e.g. Canva) who then successfully taught online courses to hundreds of participants using a combination of these technologies.

* Created and managed social media accounts for Pima county EFNEP program, increasing outreach to an average of 1,000 people per day and generated ongoing online program interest and participation. 

* Designed online educational and recruiting resources such as presentations, flyers, infographics, and videos that are still being utilized by the Pima County EFNEP team. 

* Taught dozens of nutrition classes to people of all ages masterfully delivering course content in both English and Spanish (both in-person and online) using a combination of technology and hands-on activities such as exercises and cooking demonstrations.

* Recognized by supervisor and county director for skillfully navigating the team to deliver our program remotely.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted in setting up the course content for an online Public Health undergraduate course.

Graded course assignments and assisted students in understanding the concepts relating to minority health, health disparities, health inequities, social determinants of health, etc.

company.name: Mel and Enid Zuckerman College of Public Health

positions.title: Project Research Assistant
positions.description: I performed phone interviews of mental health providers for the National Mental Health Services Survey sponsored by the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Association (SAMHSA).  I also interviewed parents about their access to food for the EDECH project sponsored by the USDA FNS.

positions.title: Coordinating Assistant
positions.description:
Worked as an interpreter and host for asylum-seeking families.

Coordinated volunteers and resources for asylum-seeking families.

Managed data collection and data entry for the project.

positions.title: Callcenter Agent
positions.description: Received calls from Verizon Wireless Customers and assisted them with billing, troubleshooting, and equipment orders.

positions.title: Resource Coordinator
positions.description: As the Resource Coordinator/ Social Media Admin I updated client contact information and recruited dozens of participants for each planned event through social media and other communication methods maintaining participant engagement both online and in-person.

positions.title: Resource Coordinator/Social Media Admin
positions.description:
Iskashitaa Refugee Network in a local non-profit organization that helps refugees integrate into the Tucson community through programs such as harvesting and food workshops.

* Updated and organized client contact information on an Excel spreadsheet helping the organization retain current participants and re-establish a connection with previous participants.

* Applied professional and interpersonal skills and recruited dozens of participants through social media, email, and through community events maintaining steady client, volunteer, and donor engagement both online and in-person.

* Demonstrated strong multi-tasking skills by planning and teaching weekly food workshops and cooking, packaging, and selling dozens of food products sold to generate hundreds of dollars for the organization.

volunteerExperiences.description:
* Displayed strong research and communication skills by conducting a community health assessment for the BKL community gathering socioeconomic, environmental, and historical data from reputable scientific and governmental resources and from BKL leaders and community members.

* Generated a thorough Program and Evaluation Plan based on the findings of the assessment that aided the non-profit organization to apply for grants and secure funding for their community garden project.

projects.title: Events Near You!
projects.description: Users can search upcoming events by location or by artist and save them to their profile.  Users can follow links in generated cards to search for that artist or group's event tickets on Ticketmaster. Saved event cards can also be deleted.

projects.title: Cities2See
projects.description: Users can login and search cities that they want to save in their profile and visit later. Cities are saved in dynamically generated cards with information from the GeoDB Cities API.
